name: vwap_gap_fill_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY opens with a 0.25-1.5% gap from the previous session's VWAP, every VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithm (representing ~40-60% of NSE derivatives volume by notional) is immediately mis-positioned against its daily benchmark — a gap-up means they paid too much relative to yesterday's volume-weighted consensus, a gap-down means they received too little. Unlike the previous close, previous VWAP reflects where most volume actually transacted, so algorithms with VWAP mandates will systematically work to close this gap throughout the morning (09:20-10:30), creating a persistent directional drift of 1-3 NIFTY spot points per minute. At 5-second resolution, we detect active fill momentum — price through the 60-second EMA in the fill direction with positive 1-minute return — and enter 30-90 second legs aligned with this institutional drift.
core_signal_oneliner: NIFTY gaps 0.25-1.5% from prior session VWAP, then shows active fill momentum confirmed by EMA and 1-min return alignment
